doc: enemy-ai stations for the arena: the pit waves and the 00:00 sample fight on the cast rigs. stations.doc: The owner's 00:00 sample, enemy half: a patrol cop (pistol, aim-line tell, flinches on a near miss) and a robot thug (claw: windup, lunge along the locked aim, swing), already alert, staged by PitLayout.place: Rivet at (-5, 0) m, patrol_cop at (9, -6), robot_thug at (-1, 2.5).
